title: Information Bottleneck & Representation Learning
interviewAnswer: The information-bottleneck view seeks representations that preserve information useful for a target while discarding irrelevant detail.
why: It provides a useful conceptual lens for learned compression and representation learning.
intuition: A good representation should keep structure needed by the downstream task without memorizing every nuisance detail.
deepDive: The classical objective trades information retained about input against information retained about the target. Estimating these quantities in deep networks is nontrivial, so it is often a guiding principle rather than a literal measured objective.
commonMistakes: Assuming smaller latent means more semantic.
Claiming the theory is directly measurable in every deep model.
followUps: How does this relate to VAEs/VQ models?
production: Choose bottlenecks by downstream quality, storage and latency trade-offs.
workedExample: A compressed image code may discard sensor noise while retaining boundaries needed for prediction.
